Privacy

Privacy policy

Effective November 9, 2026

Coal River Standard collects only the information you choose to send through the website inquiry form, such as your name, business name, general location, email address, website link, message category, and project goals.

How we use your information

We use submitted information to review your request, respond to you, and discuss a possible website project. We do not sell your personal information or use it for unrelated marketing.

How submissions are handled

Form submissions are processed and stored by Netlify, our website hosting provider. Netlify may filter submissions for spam and applies its own terms and privacy practices to that processing.

How long we keep it

We keep inquiry information only as long as reasonably needed to respond, maintain business records, or meet legal obligations. You may ask us to correct or delete your inquiry information.

Third-party links

This website may link to third-party services. Their privacy practices are controlled by their own policies.

Questions or requests

Email coalriverstandard@gmail.com to ask a privacy question or request access, correction, or deletion.
